notes.title: Aurora Update 2.5 Patch!!
notes.content:
[i]Whats good everyone today I'm back with an exciting update to Aurora Chronicles. As for today Ive been looking at some of the functionality of the game and finally fixed a huge bug which impacted the performance of players causing them to restart the game. It caused many problem but now that its removed and patched it will make the gameplay much more enjoyable.[/i]
 
As for the next change I've added a blood splash indicator for the HUD, this will further give players a better indication on how they should play, more passive or aggressively depending on how far you are in the survival aspect of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OAsACbA.jpeg[/img]

Following the final change for the build I've also adjusted the necromancer's Summon ability. Previously each necro was able to spawn as many enemies whenever they finished their summon ability either spawning the Demon Bat or the Elemental Golem, but currently with the new change each necromancer is able to summon only once between those two previously stated enemies. This was an important change in order for the player to not feel too overwhelmed on the battlefield when facing a wide variety of enemies but instead gives the player a better chance at utilizing their skills and surviving in Orellia.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GBiJZjd.jpeg[/img]

[i]Thats all for the update thanks for checking it out and be sure to tune in for more![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TshCnOQ.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Aurora Patch 2.0 Update
notes.content:
Good evening everyone today the [b]new patch 2.0[/b] has dropped for [b]Aurora Chronicles [/b]below listed are a few details regarding the update.
There are 3 new enemies entering the world Orellia they are the Necromancer, Elemental Golem as well as the Demon Bat each have different characteristics and play styles which will force the player to adjust to each situation.
NecroMancer
[b]The Necromancer[/b] has 2 abilities the first is a wall which blocks you from passing and has a slight chance to hurt you if you collide.
The 2nd ability the necromancer summons a wall of deathfire if the player gets too close and if you so happen to collide with this fire you will take heavy damage.
The trick to beating necromancer is to only attack during the wall summon and not the deathfire.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZfzLact.png[/img]

[b]The Demon Bat[/b] is another fast enemy such as the goblin he will fly around your head and distract you from stronger enemies but alas they are easy to deal with.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c5VS0ly.png[/img]

[b]The Elemental Golem[/b] is a big brute like the reaper , he attacks with a fire and ice abiity, with the fire ability there's a chance it will burn you and with the ice ability there's a chance it will freeze you so you must be careful when dealing with this foe.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/onynofB.png[/img]
